The shape was wrong, and this is what the tree actually holds. ADR-0052 replaced a counter FIELD, and `fields.Count` can express nothing else, but the gate counted any `len(record.x_ids)` anywhere in a `_compute*`. Roughly eighty of the sites it flagged were legitimate uses with no fix: `len(move.suitable_journal_ids) > 1` is a boolean, `i == len(self.line_ids) - 1` is an index bound, `done = len(enrollment.completion_ids)` is a ratio numerator bound to a local.

The finding is now the whole assignment -- `<name>.<counter> = len(<name>.<field>_ids)` -- with both halves naming the same record, since `a.n = len(b.line_ids)` counts b onto a and is not a field on the record counted.

  addons 84 -> 58   account 13 -> 6   mail 2 -> 0   stock 3 -> 2
  enterprise 97 -> 60   agromarin 21 -> 14   core and project unchanged

mail reaching 0 is a real zero, not a vacuous one: the scope is scanned, has computes and x2many fields, and simply carries no hand-written counter. The floor still earns its place by refusing the first one back.

Found by reading the sites while trying to drive the floor down, which is the second correction this gate has taken for the same reason -- a finding that cannot be acted on is not a finding.
